_readme: Defect registry. Key = pytest node id (exact case) or function id (all its cases). Fields: id, severity, status (confirmed | under_investigation | spec_gap), summary, ticket, review_by. One status per defect id. Default run ignores this file and bugs FAIL. XFAIL_KNOWN_BUGS=1 strict-xfails status=confirmed entries until review_by. Details in BUGS.md. intermittent=true (race bugs that reproduce in only some runs) gives a NON-strict xfail so a lucky pass does not break the build.
